description: Exploratory H1 J8 follow-up to the actor-BatchNorm screen: reduce actor and its tied adaptive-temperature learning rate from 5e-5 to 6.25e-6, retaining critic LR5e-5 and all other J8 settings. Matched return/return and soft/soft critics, N256/G3/B256/delay3, frozen inherited actor BatchNorm statistics and frozen real reward scale. This changes actor and temperature step sizes, not update counts, and is not a tuned or confirmatory protocol.

controller.description: J8 matched critic routes with actor and tied temperature LR6.25e-6; critic LR5e-5.

prior.description: Frozen main XQC actor mean; reuse matching completed prior episodes.

return_return_j8.description: H1 J8; return_return critic initialization and frozen outer horizon; inherited adaptive actor alpha. N256/G3/B256/delay3, actor and tied temperature LR6.25e-6; critic LR5e-5. Actor BatchNorm uses frozen inherited running statistics; affine parameters and alpha adapt.

soft_soft_j8.description: H1 J8; soft_soft critic initialization and frozen outer horizon; inherited adaptive actor alpha. N256/G3/B256/delay3, actor and tied temperature LR6.25e-6; critic LR5e-5. Actor BatchNorm uses frozen inherited running statistics; affine parameters and alpha adapt.
